question: Suppose $a,b$ and $n$ are positive integers, all greater than one. If $a^n+b^n$ is prime, what can you say about $n$?

options.B: The integer $n$ need not be 2, but must be a power of 2;
options.C: The integer $n$ need not be a power of 2, but must be even;
options.D: None of the above is necessarily true.

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10 + 2 Level
